entities.description: The PANTRI System shall create an unapproved purchase-draft version reflecting each accepted manager quantity revision.
entities.rationale:
Rationale: Revision must preserve manager control without commitment. Higher-level source: SR.03A; P-SFR.01. Allocated function: P-F.0.3.1. MOP: Revision quantity unit and version agreement. Proposed verification criterion: Revise beef from 4 to 5 kg in the prepared 4/6/1 kg draft; the revised version is 5/6/1 kg, remains unapproved and produces no transmission. Invalid quantities are rejected. Method: Test. Verification status: Planned; no implementation or operational acceptance result is inferred from the architecture model.
Quantified design MOP clarification: 100 x valid revision fixtures preserving quantity, unit, version and unapproved state / valid revision fixtures [%]; target 100%; accepted invalid revisions = 0. Nonempty denominators are fixed by the independent fixture manifest before execution.

entities.description: The PANTRI System shall record explicit Restaurant Manager approval with the restaurant identifier and the approved final purchase-draft version.
entities.rationale:
Rationale: Approval authorizes a specific commitment. Higher-level source: SR.03; P-SFR.01. Allocated function: P-F.0.3.2. MOP: Approval version and restaurant association agreement. Proposed verification criterion: Record approval of a selected draft and compare the retained immutable snapshot; editing creates a new unapproved version and cannot reuse the stale approval. Method: Test. Verification status: Planned; no implementation or operational acceptance result is inferred from the architecture model.
Quantified design MOP clarification: 100 x approvals bound to the correct restaurant, final version and immutable snapshot / valid approval fixtures [%]; target 100%; stale approvals reused = 0. Nonempty denominators are fixed by the independent fixture manifest before execution.

entities.description: The PANTRI System shall transmit a purchase order only when its restaurant identifier, final version, ingredient identifiers, quantities and units agree with its explicit manager approval record.
entities.rationale:
Rationale: The supplier must receive the authorized version unchanged. Higher-level source: SR.03; P-SFR.01. Allocated function: P-F.0.3.3. MOP: Unauthorized transmissions and approved-to-sent discrepancies. Proposed verification criterion: Unapproved, revised-after-approval and wrong-restaurant cases produce zero handoffs; a valid 5/6/1 kg approval produces an exactly matching supplier payload. Duplicate attempts do not create a second commitment. Method: Test. Verification status: Planned; no implementation or operational acceptance result is inferred from the architecture model.
Quantified design MOP clarification: Unauthorized or duplicate commitments = 0 events; approved-to-sent payload discrepancies = 0 fields. Nonempty denominators are fixed by the independent fixture manifest before execution.

entities.description: The PANTRI System shall update the recorded supplier order state only from a valid associated supplier response or an explicitly recorded pending or exception event.
entities.rationale:
Rationale: Sending is distinct from confirmation and delivery. Higher-level source: SR.04, SR.11; P-SFR.01. Allocated function: P-F.0.3.4. MOP: Invalid confirmation transitions and valid response association rate. Proposed verification criterion: Test absent, normal, partial, delayed and wrong-order responses; absence stays unconfirmed and wrong-order responses do not change the order. Status retains supporting response reference. Method: Test. Verification status: Planned; no implementation or operational acceptance result is inferred from the architecture model.
Quantified design MOP clarification: 100 x valid responses associated with the correct order and state / valid response fixtures [%]; target 100%; invalid state changes = 0 events. Nonempty denominators are fixed by the independent fixture manifest before execution.

entities.description: The Purchase Coordination Subsystem shall deny 100% of prepared unauthorized purchase tasks while completing at least 95% of prepared legitimate purchase tasks under the agreed restaurant and task policy.
entities.rationale:
Rationale: Equivalence: the same denial and legitimate-completion thresholds apply to the component task subset; weakening either gate could violate the system policy.
MOP: Denied unauthorized / unauthorized = 100%; completed legitimate / legitimate >= 95%; nonzero predeclared sets.
Verification criterion: Exercise every module with valid manager, wrong restaurant, staff approval, stale policy and denied support cases; denied operations disclose no protected state and perform no mutation.
Method: Test and inspection
Status: Draft; verification not executed.
